text: In accordance with Section 9A of the Consolidated Rules of Procedure for the Property Standards Committee, as amended, each Panel shall adopt a schedule of meetings to hear appeals for each year. Please note that meetings for the Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel will be held remotely until further notice.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Approved the following meeting dates for 2024: - Thursday, January 25 at 9:30 a.m. - Thursday, February 29 at 9:30 a.m. - Thursday, March 21 at 9:30 a.m. - Thursday, April 18 at 9:30 a.m. - Thursday, May 16 at 9:30 a.m. - Thursday, June 13 at 9:30 a.m. - Thursday, July 18 at 9:30 a.m. - Thursday, September 19 at 9:30 a.m. - Thursday, October 24 at 9:30 a.m. - Thursday, November 28 at 9:30 a.m.
